Below is a Crossplane XRD and a pipeline-mode Composition using `function-patch-and-transform`. It creates:

- A private, versioned, AES-256 encrypted S3 bucket
- An RDS PostgreSQL instance with deletion protection and at least seven days of backups
- An IAM role with OIDC trust suitable for Kubernetes service accounts
- A least-privilege S3 access policy attached to the role

The RDS password is referenced from an existing Kubernetes Secret and is never embedded in these manifests.

> Assumes the Upbound AWS provider APIs and `function-patch-and-transform` are installed.

```yaml
# function.yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform:v0.8.2
```

```yaml
# xrd.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xversionedapplications.platform.example.org
spec:
  group: platform.example.org
  names:
    kind: XVersionedApplication
    plural: xversionedapplications
  claimNames:
    kind: VersionedApplication
    plural: versionedapplications
  defaultCompositionRef:
    name: versioned-application-aws
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          required:
            - spec
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              required:
                - environment
                - region
                - providerConfigName
                - bucketName
                - database
                - serviceAccountRole
              properties:
                environment:
                  type: string
                  enum:
                    - dev
                    - prod

                region:
                  type: string
                  description: AWS region for the primary resources.

                providerConfigName:
                  type: string
                  description: Environment-specific AWS ProviderConfig.

                bucketName:
                  type: string
                  description: Globally unique S3 bucket name.

                database:
                  type: object
                  required:
                    - instanceClass
                    - allocatedStorage
                    - multiAZ
                    - storageEncrypted
                    - username
                    - passwordSecretRef
                  properties:
                    instanceClass:
                      type: string
                    allocatedStorage:
                      type: integer
                      minimum: 20
                    multiAZ:
                      type: boolean
                    storageEncrypted:
                      type: boolean
                    username:
                      type: string
                    databaseName:
                      type: string
                      default: app
                    passwordSecretRef:
                      type: object
                      required:
                        - name
                        - namespace
                        - key
                      properties:
                        name:
                          type: string
                        namespace:
                          type: string
                        key:
                          type: string

                serviceAccountRole:
                  type: object
                  required:
                    - name
                    - oidcProviderArn
                    - oidcIssuer
                    - namespace
                    - serviceAccountName
                  properties:
                    name:
                      type: string
                    oidcProviderArn:
                      type: string
                      description: ARN of the EKS cluster IAM OIDC provider.
                    oidcIssuer:
                      type: string
                      description: >-
                        OIDC issuer without the https:// prefix, for example
                        oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE.
                    namespace:
                      type: string
                    serviceAccountName:
                      type: string

            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketArn:
                  type: string
                databaseEndpoint:
                  type: string
                roleArn:
                  type: string
```

```yaml
# composition.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: versioned-application-aws
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
    kind: XVersionedApplication

  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    - step: patch-and-transform
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:
          # Main S3 bucket.
          - name: bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: Bucket
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.org/resource: assets-bucket
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  forceDestroy: false
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.bucketArn
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

          # S3 versioning is modeled as a separate AWS resource.
          - name: bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.org/resource: assets-versioning
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          # Default server-side encryption using Amazon S3-managed AES-256 keys.
          - name: bucket-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.org/resource: assets-encryption
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  rule:
                    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          # Explicitly block all forms of public S3 access.
          - name: bucket-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.org/resource: assets-public-access
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          # PostgreSQL RDS instance.
          - name: postgres
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Instance
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.org/resource: postgres
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  engine: postgres
                  instanceClass: db.t3.micro
                  allocatedStorage: 20
                  storageType: gp3
                  multiAz: false
                  storageEncrypted: true
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  deletionProtection: true
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  autoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
                  copyTagsToSnapshot: true
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  finalSnapshotIdentifier: placeholder-final-snapshot
                  dbName: app
                  username: appadmin
                  passwordSecretRef:
                    name: placeholder
                    namespace: crossplane-system
                    key: password
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.instanceClass
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.allocatedStorage
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.multiAZ
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.storageEncrypted
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.storageEncrypted

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.username
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.databaseName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.passwordSecretRef.name
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.name

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.passwordSecretRef.namespace
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.namespace

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.database.passwordSecretRef.key
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.key

              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  strategy: string
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: metadata.uid
                  string:
                    fmt: "postgres-final-%s"
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.finalSnapshotIdentifier

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
                toFieldPath: status.databaseEndpoint
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

          # IAM role trusted only by the selected EKS OIDC provider and service
          # account subject.
          - name: service-account-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.org/resource: service-account-role
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  assumeRolePolicy: "{}"
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountRole.name
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  strategy: string
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountRole.oidcProviderArn
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountRole.oidcIssuer
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountRole.namespace
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountRole.serviceAccountName
                  string:
                    fmt: >-
                      {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Federated":"%s"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"%s:sub":"system:serviceaccount:%s:%s"}}}]}
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy

              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.roleArn
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional

          # Least-privilege application-assets policy. It grants only the
          # explicit list/read/write/delete actions required for the bucket.
          - name: service-account-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Policy
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.org/resource: service-account-policy
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  policy: "{}"
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  strategy: string
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountRole.name
                  string:
                    fmt: "%s-assets"
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]

              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  strategy: string
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                  string:
                    fmt: >-
                      {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"ListBucket","Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketLocation"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::%s"},{"Sid":"ObjectAccess","Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:GetObjectVersion","s3:PutObject","s3:DeleteObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"}]}
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy

          - name: service-account-policy-attachment
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicyAttachment
              metadata:
                labels:
                  platform.example.org/resource: service-account-policy-attachment
              spec:
                deletionPolicy: Delete
                forProvider:
                  policyArnSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  roleSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
```

```yaml
# dev.yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedApplication
metadata:
  name: assets-dev
  namespace: applications-dev
spec:
  environment: dev
  region: us-east-1
  providerConfigName: aws-dev

  bucketName: example-assets-dev-123456789012

  database:
    instanceClass: db.t3.micro
    allocatedStorage: 20
    multiAZ: false
    storageEncrypted: true
    username: appadmin
    databaseName: app
    passwordSecretRef:
      name: assets-dev-db-password
      namespace: crossplane-secrets
      key: password

  serviceAccountRole:
    name: assets-dev-service-account
    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVEXAMPLE
    oidcIssuer: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVEXAMPLE
    namespace: application
    serviceAccountName: assets
---
# prod.yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedApplication
metadata:
  name: assets-prod
  namespace: applications-prod
spec:
  environment: prod
  region: us-east-1
  providerConfigName: aws-prod

  bucketName: example-assets-prod-123456789012

  database:
    instanceClass: db.t3.medium
    allocatedStorage: 100
    multiAZ: true
    storageEncrypted: true
    username: appadmin
    databaseName: app
    passwordSecretRef:
      name: assets-prod-db-password
      namespace: crossplane-secrets
      key: password

  serviceAccountRole:
    name: assets-prod-service-account
    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODEXAMPLE
    oidcIssuer: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODEXAMPLE
    namespace: application
    serviceAccountName: assets
```

The referenced password Secrets should be provisioned through an external secret manager, Crossplane SecretStore/ProviderSecret mechanism, or committed only in SOPS-encrypted form. Separate `aws-dev` and `aws-prod` ProviderConfigs provide environment credential and state isolation. Cross-region S3 replication, EKS, and HTTPS resources are outside the three resources requested here.
